headline: SPK's Response to the Claim "Borsa Istanbul Has Warned 130 Times Since 2025 About Suspicious Transactions in Funds"
summary: The Capital Markets Board (SPK) responded to claims that Borsa Istanbul warned 130 times since 2025 about suspicious fund transactions. It said its audits led to sanctions totalling 2.741 billion lira on individuals and firms in 2025.
why: The Capital Markets Board supervises Turkish securities markets, and enforcement actions against suspicious trading affect investor confidence in Borsa Istanbul.
